# Florida Movers Direct

> Free referral service that connects Florida residents with up to 4 independent, licensed moving companies. Florida Movers Direct is not a moving company: movers in the network hold FDACS registration (moves inside Florida) or FMCSA authority with a USDOT number (interstate moves). Comparing quotes is free and has no obligation.

Florida Movers Direct covers local hourly moves, long-distance and interstate moves, commercial and office relocations, packing, storage, piano and specialty moves, furniture-only moves, labor-only moving help, apartment and condo moves, and senior moves across Florida. Typical local rates for a two-mover crew with a truck run $95-$150 per hour; long-distance moves typically run $2,200-$6,500+. Prices on the site are estimates; only a written quote from a mover is binding. Anyone can verify a Florida mover with FDACS (https://www.fdacs.gov/Business-Services/Moving-Companies) or FMCSA SAFER (https://safer.fmcsa.dot.gov/).
